activity_summary: At home you said he was happy, and that you never heard him so. The drawer has verse in it, and not a leaf would fit a pair of gloves for a lady he did not name. You are his to command, and you said so in print. You wrote nothing for it tonight.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was happy, and wrote nothing for the gloves.

entities.name: Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southampton
entities.context: Not in the house. The ask is his, and the night is not.

facets.activity: Did not write for the gloves
